title: KVEraser: Learning to Steer KV Cache for Efficient Localized Context Erasing
authors: Mufei Li; Shikun Liu; Dongqi Fu; Haoyu Wang; Yinglong Xia; Hong Li; Hong Yan; Pan Li
venue_full: ICML 2026 Workshop on the Impact of Memorization on Trustworthy Foundation Models
research_focus: Long-context / Prefix cache, Agentic / Workflow serving

problem_statement.en: After a context has been prefilled, deleting a short stale, incorrect, or harmful span invalidates the KV states of every later token because the span's influence has propagated through the suffix. Exact context erasing therefore requires recomputing the entire suffix, making cost scale with suffix length rather than erased-span length.
problem_statement.zh: context 完成 prefill 後，若刪除短小且過時、錯誤或有害的 span，由於其影響已沿 suffix 傳播，後續所有 token 的 KV state 都會失效。精確 context erasing 因而必須重算整個 suffix，使成本隨 suffix length 而非 erased-span length 擴張。

key_innovation.en: KVEraser uses a trainable eraser initialized from the generator backbone to replace only the erased interval's KV states with length-preserving steering states conditioned on the preserved prefix cache and erased span, while reusing the remaining prefix and suffix cache unchanged. Two-stage span-neighbor pre-training and task-specific fine-tuning teach the surrogate cache to reproduce counterfactual decoding behavior.
key_innovation.zh: KVEraser 採用由 generator backbone 初始化的 trainable eraser，根據 preserved prefix KV cache 與 erased span 產生等長 steering state，僅替換待刪除區間的 KV state，並維持其餘 prefix 與 suffix cache 不變。兩階段的 span-neighbor pre-training 與 task-specific fine-tuning，訓練 surrogate cache 重現刪除該 span 後的 counterfactual decoding behavior。

baselines_compared: Full recompute, Delete-and-shift, Instruction-only forgetting, Local suffix repair (erase), Local suffix repair (query)

key_improvements.en: On the controlled NIAH benchmark, KVEraser achieves near-perfect exact match across 1K–32K contexts, matching full recomputation; over this range, its latency increases by only 24% versus 17.6x for full recomputation. On unseen long-document QA, it performs best among approximate baselines and delivers a 3–4x speedup over full recomputation.
key_improvements.zh: 在 controlled NIAH benchmark 上，KVEraser 於 1K–32K context 皆取得近乎完美的 exact match，與 full recomputation 相當；此範圍內其 latency 僅增加 24%，full recomputation 則增加 17.6x。在未見過的 long-document QA 上，KVEraser 在 approximate baseline 中表現最佳，並較 full recomputation 加速 3–4x。

compute_memory_hw: NVIDIA A100 80GB, 1.7 TiB RAM, 24 CPU cores

reuse_metric.en: No reuse-rate percentage is reported. By replacing only the erased interval and reusing the remaining KV cache unchanged, KVEraser achieves near-perfect exact match across 1K–32K contexts, matching full recomputation; across three unseen QA datasets, its average exact match is 0.879.
reuse_metric.zh: 論文未報告重用率百分比。KVEraser 僅替換待刪除區間並重用其餘 KV cache，在 1K–32K context 上取得近乎完美的 exact match，與 full recomputation 相當；在三個未見過的 QA 資料集上，其平均 exact match 為 0.879。
